title: A multiwavelength study of multiple spectral component jets in AGN: testing the IC/CMB model for the large-scale-jet X-ray emission
question: Whether the inverse-Compton scattering of the cosmic microwave background (IC/CMB) model can explain the anomalous large-scale X-ray emission in 45 extragalactic Multiple Spectral Component (MSC) AGN jets when tested against Fermi/LAT gamma-ray observations and multi-wavelength SEDs.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image radio/sub-mm interferometric data (VLA, ALMA, ATCA) and measure jet knot flux densities
recipe.method: Calibrate visibilities via CASA pipeline (scriptForPI.py for ALMA) or manual calibration, image with tclean/clean using Briggs robust=0.5 and MTMFS (nterms=2), apply phase and amplitude self-calibration, and extract flux densities or 95% upper limits.
assumptions: 35% uncertainty on measured jet component flux densities (~20% absolute flux calibration, ~15% cross-frequency comparison)

recipe.goal: Reduce HST archival optical/IR/UV imaging and measure jet knot photometry
recipe.method: Download flat-fielded images processed by calwf3 from MAST, fit and subtract core PSF and host galaxy Sersic models in GALFIT, combine dithered frames with Astrodrizzle, and measure jet flux densities or RMS upper limits.
key_parameters: Single Sersic component for host galaxy; nearby stars, TinyTim, or dedicated PSF star for PSF model
assumptions: Extinction corrections from Schlafly & Finkbeiner (2011) and aperture corrections from Bohlin (2016)

recipe.goal: Reprocess Chandra X-ray observations and fit X-ray knot spectra
recipe.method: Reprocess events with chandra_repro (0.4-8 keV), filter flares >2 sigma above mean, align and merge multi-epoch observations with merge_obs, sub-pixel bin by 0.2, extract spectra with spectract, and fit absorbed power-law in SHERPA.
key_parameters: Energy range 0.4-8 keV, flare cut > 2 sigma, image binning 0.2 ACIS-S pixel, spectral binning 1 ct/bin
assumptions: Galactic hydrogen absorption column density fixed to reference sky location value from WebPIMMS

recipe.goal: Extract Fermi/LAT gamma-ray flux upper limits or minimum steady fluxes using recombined light curves
recipe.method: Perform binned likelihood analysis in 5 energy bands over 100 MeV-100 GeV. For non-4FGL sources, compute 95% upper limits over the full dataset. For 4FGL sources, bin into 3-week GTI light curves, sort bins from lowest to highest TS, and contiguously recombine bins to find minimum flux/upper limits.
key_parameters: ROI = 10 deg, energy = 100 MeV-100 GeV, zenith cut = 90 deg, event class = 128, event type = 3, 30 log energy bins, 0.2 deg spatial bins, 3-week GTI time bins, detection threshold TS = 10
assumptions: Galactic diffuse model gll_iem_v07.fits, isotropic template iso_P8R3_SOURCE_V3_v1.txt, photon index fixed at 2 for non-4FGL point sources

recipe.goal: Construct broadband SEDs, fit synchrotron and IC/CMB models, and derive Doppler and Lorentz factor upper limits
recipe.method: Fit phenomenological power-law with exponential cutoff models by eye to radio-to-optical synchrotron SEDs, shift in frequency and luminosity via IC/CMB equations to match X-ray flux, compare predicted GeV flux against Fermi limits, and calculate equipartition magnetic fields B_eq, Doppler factor limits delta, and kpc-scale Lorentz factor limits Gamma_max,kpc.
key_parameters: gamma_min = 10 for EED in equipartition calculation
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with H0 = 67.74 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_lambda = 0.69, Omega_m = 0.31; equipartition magnetic field; kpc-scale jet viewing angle theta < theta_max from pc-scale VLBI

recipe.goal: Decompose radio spectra, compute orientation indicators, and perform sample correlation and beaming analyses
recipe.method: Decompose NED radio spectra into core and lobe components to compute R_CE, L_ext, L_kin, and orientation indicator OI; perform 10,000-trial bootstrap Spearman rank correlation tests and OLS linear regression on (alpha_r, alpha_x) and (log R_x, log R_CE); compare with single-zone and two-zone spine-sheath beaming models.
key_parameters: 10,000 bootstrap trials, significance threshold p-value < 0.05, well-measured spectral index error threshold < 0.4
assumptions: Core spectral index = 0, large-scale jet radio spectral index = 0.7, initial jet alignment = 5 degrees for misalignment curves

score_reason: Raw data are public and the high-level multi-wavelength reduction and Fermi light-curve recombination workflows are clearly described, but full reproduction is hindered by by-eye SED fitting with unstated model parameters, missing aperture region definitions, and reliance on external online-only tables for the observation log and numeric flux/limit tables.
rediscovery_reason: All raw radio/ALMA, HST, Chandra, and Fermi/LAT data are public, and the core scientific outcome—whether IC/CMB gamma-ray predictions exceed Fermi/LAT limits and the resulting kpc-scale Lorentz factor limits and sample correlation statistics—is numeric and well-defined.
